description: Measure wall thickness across faces via ray grid sampling. Returns min/max/avg thickness per face. Use direction_mode="normal" (default) or direction_mode="axis".

bidirectional.description: Fire rays in both directions. Default true for thickness.

detail.description: stats = min/max/avg only; samples = include hit coordinates.

direction.description: Ray direction [x,y,z]. Mutually exclusive with direction_mode.

direction_mode.description: Direction shortcut. axis = along the face axis; normal = along the face normal.

faces.description: Face IDs to measure wall thickness across.

file_path.description: Path to STEP file on local filesystem.

spacing_mm.description: Grid spacing in mm. Smaller = denser sampling.

name: measure_thickness
